d:
In this video, I continue my journey through northern Chile and explore one of the most incredible landscapes in the Atacama Desert, Valle de la Luna, or the Valley of the Moon.
I started this journey after spending the night camping near Valle de la Luna. There was no tent or comfortable campsite. I simply turned my Chevrolet Colorado 4x4 into my home for the night and slept inside the car, surrounded by one of the driest and most unusual landscapes on Earth.
